run_generate_object_id_frame_map: run generate_object_id_frame_map to build a scene-to-frame-filenames map and save it as a pickle file
run_generate_relevant_frames_clip: run generate_relevant_frames_clip to compute CLIP image and text embeddings for 3D scene frames and utterances
create_normalize_caption: create a normalized caption by lowercasing and removing punctuation and spaces from a text string
build_clip_image_embeddings: build CLIP image embeddings for all frames in a scene using jinaai/jina-clip-v1 and save as torch tensor
build_clip_text_embeddings: build CLIP text embeddings from reference dataset utterances and save with MD5 hashes for lookup
